CC0 1.0 Universal

The fallback fixture is derived from the repository's Aegisub GDI Variant
Fixture regular font. Both fixtures and their generators are dedicated to
the public domain under CC0 1.0. The fallback changes the test character map
to space and B and gives the font a distinct family and face name.

https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
